request.prompt: Premium fantasy mobile RPG skill VFX, hand-painted with luminous volumetric light, bright white-hot cores fading into rich saturated colour, fine sparks and particles, soft glow, NO outlines, NO cartoon line art. IMPORTANT: the whole image is one continuous solid pure black background; every cell sits on the same pure black, no grey, white or coloured cell backgrounds. A sprite sheet: 16 sequential animation frames of ONE effect in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, the effect centred in each cell with black margin all round so nothing touches a cell edge, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a burst of shadow magic at the centre as a blow of dark magic lands: a violet-black implosion that explodes outward as purple-black smoke with magenta sparks. Frames 1 to 2: a dark core with a magenta rim. Frames 3 to 7: shadow smoke and wisps burst outward. Frames 8 to 12: the smoke billows and curls with sparks. Frames 13 to 16: it thins and fades until the last frame is nearly black.
